repos_data.description: From idea to object, and every version in between. Kiln is the open-source MCP server for 3D printing: AI agents (ChatGPT, Claude, Codex, Cursor, Gemini, Grok, Hermes Agent, or any MCP client) design, slice and print on Bambu Lab, Creality, Prusa, Elegoo, Klipper, OctoPrint and more. Git-style version control: branch, merge and undo your designs.
